rationale:
Accept this exact frozen world proposal and raw native audit as the independent quality final for quality-v2-c1. The source, candidate, own initial acceptance, proposal and audit match their assigned bytes. All nine current source bindings, including the newly written quick catalog, current pack and rankings, and all 150 recorded runtime hashes match the files inspected now; HEAD/tree match the freeze. I inspected every native v1 goal and historical-save replay record, rather than relying on its six summary flags or graph reachability alone. The bound actual Go 1.27.3 execution exited 0: the no-goal run and all 32 optional-goal runs each reach the same 148-discovery complete collection of 252 concepts, retry all 352 recipes consistently, and restore the completed checkpoint. Ten historical mechanics books preserve the listed 1,156 replay prefixes and their earned concepts. The goal/history identifiers and prefix totals agree with the exact proposal.

Fresh inspection of all 352 displayed pairs/results/explanations and all 252 labels/descriptions supports the unchanged world as intelligible play. Flour plus water gives dough, water plus salt gives brine, and water plus cornmeal gives mamaliga before the first pantry unlock. Dough, puff pastry, choux pastry, brine and prepared sauces remain useful intermediates with purposeful alternatives; the twelve supply groups broaden recognizable pantry, lunch, pastry and later menus. The 32 optional goal titles fit those dishes without changing their crafting rules. The world explicitly says pairs express the idea of a dish rather than a complete cooking recipe; the explanations preserve the omitted preparation and ingredients. Specific kataif, whipping-cream, edible-fish and hot-chocolate senses prevent a new ambiguity. No concrete quality inconsistency was found.

Exact raw JSON value comparisons show the candidate's world, concepts, recipes, goals, unlocks and ten compatibility histories are unchanged from its predecessor. Proposal concept/world/goal/unlock/history values and every non-source recipe field preserve the candidate bytes. The 281 differing recipe source lists have the documented sorted unique rendering; attribution to accepted factual sources is supported by the actual prepare receipt and inspected buildWorld implementation, without opening a factual peer report body. This rendering adds no authored board, recipe meaning or concept. Own initial coverage remains complete and inherited; the verified new/changed authored item and concept lists are empty. I preserve inherited source slots under the native role-specific rules and do not manufacture URLs or apply a factual HTTP source floor to quality rows.

The current service serializes parents, explanations and sources only for owned inventory and does not serialize its recipe map. Undiscovered goal target_id remains nil; goal labels and goal IDs are intentionally shown. Goal selection affects hint preference, while crafts use the same recipe map. These code observations support the recorded privacy checks; the native v1 recipes_private flag alone is not an exhaustive HTTP privacy proof. The audit covers its deterministic productive ordering, post-closure retries, complete restores and the listed historical prefix chains, not every arbitrary craft order or save permutation. This final does not claim a live-public-network source check, human enjoyment/playtest, new real-content critic run, installation, serving, landing, native alias or whole-content qualification. World write, extensions, 4f–4i and the native alias controls remain pending; all 38 source forms remain unqualified. No peer new final, author-private source bundle or sealed key was accessed.
